knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A gas smell means stop, do not operate any switch, move people clear and call for help from outside the area.
The burner tray and igniter are gas components and are excluded from the cleaning scope.
A yellow or sooty flame can indicate incomplete combustion. That is a reason to stop and refer.
Burner cleaning is regulated gas work. The course does not grant a gasfitting or gas-servicing authority.
In Victoria, internal cleaning of Type A gas appliances is covered work for registered plumbers in the specialised class.

practicalCriteria: Identifies gas components and marks them excluded on the job record before work
Keeps cloth, spray and brush out of the burner, igniter and connector area
Describes the stop, do-not-operate and report sequence in a scenario
Does not use any flame or spark to check for a gas leak
passRule: Knowledge checks: at least 4 of 5 correct (80%). Practical sign-off is separate: an assessor observes the practical criteria and records the result. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not grant any licence or authority.
evidenceRequired: Job record with gas-fired status and excluded components
Photograph of any soot, scorch or connector condition
Referral to the gas servicing provider
stopWorkCriteria: Any smell or hiss suggesting gas
Any request to clean a burner, igniter, valve or flue
